programs.title: Life Is Messy
programs.desc: Shanelle is tired of feeling like a teenager. As a single mom living temporarily in her father's home, she and her son Elijah are feeling boxed in. programs.title: Life Is Messy
programs.desc: Matt and Sam are at their wit's end. The daily grind of raising two young kids while juggling careers and Matt's busy marathon schedule has worn them down. programs.title: Life Is Messy

programs.title: Life Is Messy
programs.desc: Kelly and Craig are so deeply passionate about their family history, their space is bursting with heirlooms; add the chaos of a new house, new baby, with no family support nearby, and that's the recipe for disorganization and stress; Kortney and Kenny help reset their home so they're not stuck in the past, while making room for new memories.

programs.title: Life Is Messy
